output.message: Welcome, Tomás! Your supply at 7 Mill Lane starts on 2026-12-04 on our prosumer plan, with electricity from the Ashford community energy scheme. The electricity your panels send to the grid, up to 6 kW, is paid at 0.082 EUR per kWh and set against your bill. Your first bill follows a month later, paid by direct debit.
